faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Full Mouth Rehabilitation Near Me

items.question: What is full mouth rehabilitation?
items.answer: Full mouth rehabilitation is a customized combination of restorative dental treatments designed to rebuild damaged teeth, replace missing teeth, improve bite function, and restore overall oral health.

items.question: Who needs full mouth rehabilitation?
items.answer: It is recommended for patients with multiple missing teeth, worn or broken teeth, severe decay, bite problems, or extensive dental damage.

items.question: How long does full mouth rehabilitation take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on individual needs and the procedures involved. It may range from a few weeks to several months.

items.question: Is full mouth rehabilitation painful?
items.answer: Modern dental techniques and appropriate anesthesia make the treatment comfortable, with minimal discomfort during recovery.

items.question: How much does full mouth rehabilitation cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the complexity of treatment, the procedures required, and the overall treatment plan. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.

items.question: Will my new smile look natural?
items.answer: Yes. Every restoration is custom-designed to match your facial features, bite, and natural teeth, creating an attractive and realistic appearance.
